doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: Dr. Moon hires him; the special bus and the saxophone
summary: Dr. Moon's medicine show offered him a job and bought him a saxophone; he describes the bus with vats, the company, and the 1926 date.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: And finally, uh, a medicine show came through Opelousa's, Dr. Moon. That's what you hear me talking about all the time. So, Dr. Moon offered me a job. He wanted me to play a saxophone and clarinet. So, Dr. Moon bought me a saxophone. Cause I didn't have no room.

Yeah. It's a medicine show. Real, I mean, it was a real fine. Well, in, in those days, uh, you'd compare almost, uh, Dr. Moon's medicine show with that one LeBlanc had. Uh-huh. LeBlanc didn't have nothing but a medicine show, but it was really a big one. But, Dr. Moon had a, had a big special-made bus at that time. Uh, probably cost about, uh, $30,000. Yeah. Yeah. We had those vats on there that we could mix that medicine in.
You mean a bus that, uh, a real, you know, was...

We had, we had real, we had a little room space away on this bus. It was almost the size of a, a railroad car. And the whole company traveled on this one, though? That's right. How many people? Oh, sometimes we had about four or five pieces in the band. But how many other people were connected with the thing? Well, it was Dr. Moon and his wife and the driver.

Of course, in those days, uh, the entertainers had to help with the work, too, you know. I had to help pitch the platform on the lot that you show it on. And the back of this bus, they had a, they had a stage built. Almost like the observation. Now, when did you join? What year was it? This was, uh, 1926.
26. Oh. You were about... The latter part of 25, right? You were about 19, 20 years old.
Yeah. That's right. So anyway, Doc bought me that, uh, at, uh, the saxophone. And, uh,
